title: Other Ways to Say "In Conclusion" (Essay Words) #shorts
description:
Other ways to say "In conclusion" in English – 5 essay words for your last paragraph.
Don't say "In conclusion". Say this instead:
• To sum up: To sum up, both plans have risks.
• In summary: In summary, the results are clear.
• Overall: Overall, the project was a success.
• To conclude: To conclude, more research is needed.
• Ultimately: Ultimately, the choice is ours.

Which one will you try today? Write it in the comments.
